review.analysis: SFMC-REQ-003 specifies that the SFMC software shall allow the pilot to select a navigation destination. This states a functional behavior required of the SFMC software, so software_requirement_status is YES. The requirement was evaluated against all defect criteria: it contains no vague degree words (VAGUE_CRITERION), undefined terms (UNDEFINED_TERM), unspecified responses (UNSPECIFIED_RESPONSE), unclear responsibility (ALLOCATION_UNCLEAR), unverifiable absolutes (UNVERIFIABLE_ABSOLUTE), escape clauses (ESCAPE_CLAUSE), or scope ambiguities (SCOPE_AMBIGUITY). It represents a standard high-level functional requirement as described in SWEHB 5.09 §3.2.1. Additionally, it does not state a safety constraint, inhibit, or hazard mitigation, so SWE-184 does not apply. Thus, quality_status is ACCEPTABLE.
review.summary: SFMC-REQ-003 clearly states a functional software requirement allowing the pilot to select a navigation destination without writing defects.
